contract.notes: Pins the transport-route authorization posture, its CDK<->runtime pairing, and the fail-closed default resolution. The conformance kit (CONFORMANCE_KIT.md) iterates the route inventory against this table so a newly derived route cannot be added without an authorization assertion.

runtime-bearer.notes: Gateway authorizer is NONE, so every request reaches the runtime; the runtime must fail closed with 401 + RFC 9728 challenge. DD-1/DD-2/DD-3 in DEFENSE_IN_DEPTH.md are mandatory.

none-public.notes: Deliberately public MCP server. Never a default; must be named.

default_predicate.predicate: facade-configured == the OAuth facade attachment (`facade`, the upstream-provider attach) is present on the construct
default_predicate.explicitly_not: routeFamily present (it is default-filled on essentially every construct) or 'facade routes attached' (the OAuth surface routes are derived for every server, so neither distinguishes a facade server from a plain one)
default_predicate.routefamily_only_with_own_validation: keeps iam; it moves only on an explicit transportPosture: runtime-bearer, which must then satisfy the pairing + defense-in-depth floor or synth fails closed

default_resolution.if: construct is facade-configured (the `facade` attachment is present)
construct is a plain transport server (no `facade` attachment)

default_resolution.default_posture: the explicit value (overrides the facade default; none-public still requires the floor)

posture_marker.location: synthesized template metadata on the construct
posture_marker.purpose: lets the conformance kit read the posture from a synthesized/deployed template and compare it with the runtime registration output

fail_closed.condition: runtime-bearer without a runtime posture declaration prop
runtime-bearer without a recorded throttle setting
runtime-bearer without an origin reachability decision
jwt without issuer and non-empty audience

fail_closed.expected: registerMCPFacade returns an error before any route is registered

fail_closed.condition: synthesized posture marker != runtime registration output

credential_free_behaviour.request: MCP transport request with no Authorization header
